description: Cancels the buyer's visit to this dealership. Use it only when the buyer says to. The buyer's go-ahead on this car stays. withdraw is different: it ends the go-ahead, and the visit with it. If the dealership already had the visit, it is told the visit is off (`told: true`). With `told: false`, the dealership never had the visit, so it is not told. The first change from an assistant that is not ChatGPT or Claude may need the buyer to tap a confirm link Ridekick emails.

id.description: The id of the request, from requests_list. For an entry of kind `single`, this is the entry's `id` from requests_list.

rowKey.description: The row key of the one dealership, from requests_get. An entry of kind `single` in requests_list has no rows: its rowKey is that entry's `id`, the same value as `id`.

name: cancel_visit
title: Cancel the visit
